description.value: Amsterdam Restaurant is a locally owned breakfast and lunch eatery that introduced Dutch pannenkoeken (crêpes) to Kamloops over 20 years ago, carving out a distinctive niche with its European-Canadian fusion menu. The cozy spot is known for its extensive dietary accommodations, including dedicated gluten-free, vegan, and vegetarian options, with particular attention to minimising cross-contamination for celiac diners. Takeout is available, making it a convenient stop for cyclists passing through Kamloops.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is comprehensive and confirms the business as an established breakfast/lunch restaurant with 20+ years of operation in Kamloops. Phone (250 377 8189) and address (#1-111 Oriole Rd) on the website match OSM tags exactly. No bike-specific amenities (rack, parking, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so those remain null; takeout and vegetarian/vegan/GF options are explicitly and repeatedly confirmed by the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, actively operating restaurant with confirmed takeout service and extensive dietary options (vegan, vegetarian, gluten-free) that would meaningfully serve touring cyclists passing through Kamloops. Bike-specific amenities are unconfirmed but the food offering is strong.
enrichment_extras.notes: Email address (amsterdam@shaw.ca) appears on the website but is not present in OSM tags.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website has a dedicated section 'Gluten Free Friendly, Vegetarian & Vegan Options' and notes celiac accommodations: 'We will go to the greatest lengths to ensure that the risk of cross contamination is minimized.' Vegan batter, smoked tempeh, vegan cheese, and coconut whipped cream listed as available ingredients
